description: This file defines a PHP interface 'NetworkExceptionInterface' within the 'Psr\Http\Client' namespace. The interface represents exceptions related to network issues when making HTTP requests and includes a method to retrieve the associated request object.

classes.name: NetworkExceptionInterface
classes.description: An interface for network-related exceptions during HTTP client operations, extending ClientExceptionInterface, with a method to obtain the RequestInterface object causing the exception.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the HTTP request associated with the network exception; may be a different object from the original request.
